manual_findings: First comma lookup precedes the native slice/toLowerCase data-prefix test; the no-comma gate follows that test.
Header slicing and semicolon splitting precede shifted media normalization; the entire payload is obtained before the validation gate.
Validation short-circuits in media type, final header marker, then original strict-validator order. Arbitrary middle parameters remain accepted; trailing semicolon fails the final-marker check.
Decode occurs once after validation, then local PDF magic validation, then the original byte-length helper in object construction. No catches or additional constraints were introduced.
isPdfBytes first evaluates byteLength >= 5, then indices 0 through 4 in order with short-circuit behavior. It does not examine PDF version or remaining content.
Success creates own keys in mediaType, sizeBytes, bytes order, retaining helper results even if an out-of-contract runtime helper result is undefined. The decoded Buffer is returned directly.
Native method, getter, decoder, and dependency exceptions propagate. No module state or extra imports/exports were added.
